Your details

Want to change the contact information, add extra information such as a new price, or use different details from before? Edit them here and every prompt below updates straight away.

Edit your contact bar details

Each detail gets its own small icon (phone, Instagram, map pin, globe) instead of a text label. The style you pick is used in every full prompt, and the extra line becomes the tagline, button or tab text of that style.

Add at least one detail to see the full prompt. Until then you are seeing the design prompt.
